entities.summary: Björn Stenvers is the CEO of the Eye Care Foundation. Before he was CEO at the Fonds de dotation de l’ICOM . He was the director of the foundation of the Official Museums of Amsterdam (2013-2016) which he also founded. Björn was the only Dutch lecturer at RANEPA (2015-2022).

entities.summary: Björn Stenvers is the CEO of the Eye Care Foundation. Before he was CEO at the Fonds de dotation de l’ICOM . He was the director of the foundation of the Official Museums of Amsterdam (2013-2016) which he also founded. Björn was the only Dutch lecturer at RANEPA (2015-2022).
